description: R shape set of the conv-dgrad test plan: real model backward-data geometries picked from the dnn-benchmarking convolution corpus (one median graph per dgrad behaviour signature per level ceiling, every model at least once). See docs/test-plans/convolution-bwd.md section 3.3.
selection: behaviour signature = conv_bwd_plan.signature() (rank, group class, C/G class, K/G class, stride-phase class, transposed-padding class, floor remainder); per signature the median-FLOP graph inside each level ceiling (standard <= 200 MFLOP and 16 MiB, comprehensive <= 8 GFLOP and 64 MiB, full <= 120 GFLOP and 1 GiB); every model at least once in standard or comprehensive; a graph sits in the lowest level that picked it
